personal_info.title: AI Engineer | GenAI Full Stack | Forward Deployed Engineer
personal_info.summary: Full stack and Generative AI engineer with 2.5+ years of production experience across healthcare and fintech, expanding into production AI engineering. Specialized in building Java/Spring Boot and Node.js backends, Angular and Next.js frontends, Kafka and Redis asynchronous distributed systems, and cutting-edge GenAI applications with LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling agents. Proven track record of cutting API response times by 20% at Carelon and 40% at Prajwal Fintech, leading engineering teams, and shipping AI audio-transcription features to production.

career_preferences.work_preference: Full-Time (Remote, Hybrid, or On-site in Bengaluru / Relocation)
career_preferences.relocation: Open to relocation and remote opportunities

ai_and_genai: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Anthropic)
AI Agents & Tool Calling (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen)

responsibilities: Own the Benefits and Insurance module within an enterprise healthcare platform end-to-end, designing backend services in Java / Spring Boot and building responsive user interfaces in Angular.
Collaborated with product managers and QA to translate complex insurance eligibility and claims logic into reliable, user-friendly features used by thousands of platform members.

Architected and developed RESTful APIs and microservices supporting core healthcare workflows, integrating both SQL and NoSQL databases to handle structured member records and semi-structured insurance data.
Optimized API response times by 20% to 30% through targeted query tuning, database indexing strategies, and removal of redundant service calls in the Benefits module.
Diagnosed performance bottlenecks using AWS monitoring tools, directly improving page responsiveness and reducing backend server load during peak platform usage.
Collaborated within an Agile team of 10+ engineers, QA analysts, and product managers in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily standups.
Led a team of developers building scalable MERN-stack financial applications with strict focus on high performance, transaction integrity, and security.
Architected the backend infrastructure leveraging Redis distributed caching, Firebase, and Apache Kafka asynchronous task queues for financial transactions.
Improved API performance by 40% through rigorous database query optimization, compound indexing, and caching layers.
Constructed automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, containerized microservices with Docker, and deployed on GCP and AWS.
Conducted comprehensive code reviews and mentored junior developers and interns on software quality and security standards.
Built and deployed an AI-powered audio-transcription feature integrated directly into the product core.
Developed scalable, high-performance UI systems with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Delivered responsive, client-focused web applications collaborating with cross-functional remote teams.

featured_projects.title: Enterprise Recruiter RAG & AI Career Representative
featured_projects.description: Production-grade RAG chatbot providing recruiters and hiring managers with verified, grounded insights into Dinesh's experience, architecture skills, and projects.
key_highlights: Dual guardrails protecting against prompt injection and hallucinated career claims.
Automated evaluation suite benchmarking faithfulness, context recall, and guardrail defense rate.
Hybrid retrieval (dense vector embeddings + BM25) with sub-second response times.

featured_projects.title: AI-Powered Audio Transcription Feature
featured_projects.description: Engineered automated speech-to-text transcription feature at MOVE37 Productions, streamlining audio-to-text processing for media productions.
key_highlights: Integrated AI transcription models with low-latency streaming audio pipelines.
Built intuitive editing interface in Next.js allowing creators to review, edit, and export transcripts.

featured_projects.title: Courier Management System
featured_projects.description: Full-stack enterprise logistics and package tracking application.
key_highlights: Built the courier tracking and dispatch service module with Spring Boot.
Implemented session timeout security to log out inactive users and created a responsive dashboard with Tailwind CSS.
